title: Dispatch: Apparatus one-action two-lever operation + Candle light/snuff/burn gating (attempt 1)
description:
Implementation dispatch for eshyra-7f0h. Read `bd show eshyra-7f0h` (reconciled 2026-10-18 spec + AC1-5), AGENTS.md, docs/importer-fix-protocol.md, docs/rules-pack-compiler.md. The worktree/branch is named after this bead and is cut from the parent branch eshyra-7f0h.

SURVEY FIRST (pointers): Apparatus ops come from scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts (~line 43, ~958) and magicItemFaithfulLifecycles.ts (~286, ~1089); the triage-stateMachine-op-set-lever-N clauses come from magicItemTriage.ts; activation ledger scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemActivationCostLedger.ts (UNTYPED_ACTIVATION_PHRASE_DISPOSITIONS, TYPED_ACTIVATION_COST_EVIDENCE); olc5.11 pack-tested state-machine path: magicItemSimpleStateMachines.ts RUNTIME_M5_CONFORMANCE_NAMES (~886) + the two landed 'olc5.11 pack-tested ...' hooks in magicItemCompiler.ts LANDED_MAGIC_ITEM_ENGINE_HOOKS; runtime src/state/itemState.ts (useItem, stateMachine transitions ~760-900, ~1300-1430) and src/orchestrator/toolUseItem.ts. Candle: magicItemCharge/budget economy 'burn-time', ops burn / cast-gate (excludes burn) / m9-cast-candle-spell.

DECISIONS (supervisor; implement, do not redesign):
A1 Apparatus of the Crab: replace the 11 set-lever-N operations with ONE operation `move-levers`, activation {cost:'action'} (printed: "A creature in the compartment can use an action to move as many as two of the apparatus's levers up or down"), and a new typed operation field `leverSelection: {tableRef:'table:apparatus-of-the-crab-levers', min:1, max:2}` (validator in src/rules/magicItemMechanics.ts; item-local name is fine — do NOT build a generic selection framework). use_item gains an optional `levers: [{lever: <int row key>, direction: 'up'|'down'}]` input that is REQUIRED for an operation with leverSelection and refused otherwise; it validates 1..2 entries, DISTINCT lever numbers present in the table, then spends exactly ONE action (the normal activation path) and returns, for the DM, each selected row's printed Up/Down cell text. A third lever = another use_item call = another action (the existing turn-resource accounting refuses a second action in the same turn as it does for any action item). Levers return to neutral after each use, so no lever position is stored; the resulting vehicle state (legs, shutters, claws, light, hatch, depth, movement, claw attacks) is DM-adjudicated.
A2 Apparatus readiness: the move-levers operation clause carries ONLY the engine work: the paid action and the lever-count/selection validation. Mirror olc5.11: give it the landed hooks {F2 'olc5.11 pack-tested paid item operation'} (and F5 only if the runtime actually transitions item state for it — it should not), backed by a real-pack conformance test. The lever effects (F5 complex state, F9 geometry/movement) are DM-adjudicated per the bead's NOT REQUIRED list: they must remain available to the DM through the existing hook-free adjudicated m5-complex-apparatus-* clauses + the green table structured-field clause (verify their sourceText still covers "After each use, a lever goes back to its neutral position" and the table reference; add one targeted adjudicated clause with verbatim sourceText only if a printed operative sentence would otherwise be lost). Remove the 11 ledger entries and add a TYPED_ACTIVATION_COST_EVIDENCE entry {item:'Apparatus of the Crab', operationId:'move-levers', cost:'action', phrase: exact printed span}.
C1 Candle of Invocation: add a two-state lit/unlit state machine (initial 'unlit'): operation `light` activation {cost:'action'} (printed "The candle's magic is activated when the candle is lit, which requires an action") transitions unlit->lit; operation `snuff` (printed "You can snuff it out early for use at a later time"; NO activation cost is printed, so none is typed — faithful-or-absent) transitions lit->unlit; the existing `burn` operation (burn-time, 1-minute increments, no activation cost, so no action is spent) must be REFUSED unless the candle is lit. If use_item has no way to gate an operation on the current state-machine state, add the narrowest field (e.g. operation `requiresState: 'lit'`) checked in useItem — if that turns out to need more than a small check, STOP and record the specific limitation in your notes instead of building more.
C2 cast-gate: the first-light alternative. activation {cost:'action'} (the lighting action; gate's own casting time is also 1 action, so no conflict — record this in the ledger entry), allowed only from 'unlit' when the candle has never burned (no burn-time spent and never lit — reuse the existing `excludes:['burn']` semantics if they already mean that; verify), destroys the candle (existing gate-use single-use onDepleted destroyed). The gate spell's effects stay DM-adjudicated (its castSpell/effect clause readiness is NOT in scope; if cast-gate stays refused for an unrelated spell hook, that is acceptable: say so).
C3 Readiness: Candle joins the olc5.11 pack-tested path (RUNTIME_M5_CONFORMANCE_NAMES or the equivalent for its M5 clause) only for the light/snuff transitions and the paid action, backed by the real-pack test. Update the ledger: remove 'Candle of Invocation/burn' and '/cast-gate' dispositions as appropriate, add TYPED evidence entries for light (and cast-gate) with exact printed spans; burn stays untyped with a disposition saying burn-time deduction costs no action. The ledger equality test must pass.
R Regenerate the canonical pack (`npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/`; default --out is scratch), `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`; regenerate the semi-structured inventory via writeCommittedOutputs() (packages/core/scripts/inventory-semi-structured-boundary.ts) with a throwaway tsx script outside the repo tree; thaw note docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/thaw-notes/2026-10-31-eshyra-7f0h-activation-grouping.md (format of the other thaw notes; exact count deltas; operations removed/added/newly ready). Update srdGeneratedPack.test.ts pins to the ACTUAL values and any operation lists that enumerate set-lever-N; never weaken other pins.

EVIDENCE (AC4, real pack, unmodified, no waiver; minimal, not a per-lever matrix):
 E1 Apparatus in combat: use_item move-levers with two distinct levers spends one action and returns both printed cells; with three levers refused; with the same lever twice refused; a second move-levers in the same turn refused for lack of an action; without levers refused.
 E2 Candle: burn while unlit refused; light spends an action and makes it lit; burn (several minutes) spends burn-time and NO turn resource; snuff -> unlit -> burn refused again; cast-gate after any burn refused; cast-gate on a fresh candle spends the action and destroys it (or, if refused by an out-of-scope spell hook, the test asserts that exact refusal and you report it).
 Negative-proof each new runtime guard once and list them in your report.

NOT REQUIRED / DO NOT: a generalized multi-operation action framework; vehicle movement/depth/air/geometry; candle light-zone or spellcasting effects; weakening any test.

PROCESS: implement; `npm run verify:worktree` from the worktree root must pass BEFORE committing; commit on your branch (message starts with your bead id); report via `bd update <your bead> --append-notes "..."` (files, decisions, count deltas, negative proofs, verify result, any limitation hit); file follow-ups with bd create; `bd close <your bead>`.
